name: glide
description: Browser-only Screen Studio: a Chrome MV3 port of Recordly's editor (auto-zoom, cursor, frame, webcam bubble) that records a tab/window/screen + mic + webcam and exports MP4/WebM.

scripts.zip: npm run build && cd dist && zip -qr ../glide-extension.zip .
scripts.test:record: npm run build && SURFACE=monitor HEADFUL=1 xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1920x1080x24' node test/record-smoke.mjs
